notes: New: Check for updates in the menu. When a new version is out, the menu shows a red dot and "Update ready"; tap Download update, then Update. You stay signed in.
Stays signed in when aTAS is busy (for example many phones opening at once at the start of a shift): it shows "aTAS is busy right now" and reconnects by itself, instead of asking for your PIN.
Kiosk: uses much less data. It downloads staff faces again only when someone enrols or a face or PIN is reset.
Split shifts: between time slots, the app says when the next slot starts and when you can check in.
